==== tluaAssertNarrowedCallee.tlua (2 errors) ====
    // A generic assertion resolves against its callee's flow-narrowed type, which need
    // not keep the declared assertion: narrowed to never, the call is an error; narrowed
    // by a guard to a never-returning overload, it asserts nothing.
    declare x: string | nil
    declare check: <T>(v: T) => asserts v is T & {}
    if not check then
      check(x)
      ~~~~~

    declare n: number | nil
    declare check2: <T>(v: T, tag: string) => asserts v is T & {}
    declare function isFail(f: unknown): f is (v: unknown, tag: number) => never
    if isFail(check2) then
      check2(n, 1)
